user.title: Create average sensor
user.description: Create a sensor that averages current source states or source history over a time window.

data_description.entities: Sensors, numbers, input numbers, weather, climate, or water heater entities to include in the average.
data_description.duration: Optional history window to average. Leave empty to average current states only.
data_description.precision: Number of decimal places used for the sensor state.
data_description.require_all_sources: Make the average unavailable if any source is missing, invalid, or older than the maximum source age. No fallback value overrides this requirement.

data_description.start: Optional template that renders the start of the history range as a datetime or timestamp. Use with end or average window.
data_description.end: Optional template that renders the end of the history range as a datetime or timestamp. Use with start or average window. Leave empty to end at now.
data_description.scan_interval: Minimum time between history recalculations. Increase this for long history windows to reduce recorder load.
data_description.process_undef_as: Optional numeric value to use when a source is unavailable or unknown. Leave empty to ignore unavailable sources.
data_description.max_source_age: Optional freshness limit. Sources older than this are ignored so stale readings do not stay in the average forever.

error.period_start_or_end_without_duration: Set an average window when using only start or only end.
error.too_many_period_options: Use no range, only an average window, or two of start, end, and average window.
